records.jp: グランドピアノって、あんまり間近で見ることって<CR>ないけど、やっぱこうやって見るとすごいなー
records.en_original: I don't think I've ever really seen a grand piano up close. It sure is incredible, huh?
records.en: I don't think I've ever really seen a grand piano up close. It sure is incredible, huh?

records.jp: 私のいた学校には、あった気はします。<CR>……単に大きいだけではないでしょうか
records.en_original: I believe I remember my school having one. It's simply a large piano, is it not?
records.en: I believe I remember my school having one. It's simply a large piano, is it not?

records.jp: うん、確かに大きい。<CR>でも、それだけじゃなくてさ……
records.en_original: Well, sure it's big, but that's not all.
records.en: Well, sure it's big, but that's not all.

records.jp: あとめっちゃ高そうなんですけど
records.en_original: They look super fancy and expensive.
records.en: They look super fancy and expensive.

records.jp: そうですね。実際高いと思います
records.en_original: Not only do they look it, I've heard they really are quite expensive.
records.en: Not only do they look it, I've heard they really are quite expensive.

records.jp: 楽器の王様とも呼ばれるくらいですし、<CR>とても精密なので、製作にも工程がかかるそうです
records.en_original: Some call them the king of instruments. They're very precise, so producing them and keeping them tuned requires a lot of labor.
records.en: Some call them the king of instruments. They're very precise, so producing them and keeping them tuned requires a lot of labor.

records.jp: ほえー。詩さん、詳しいんだね
records.en_original: Huh, you know a lot about this, huh?
records.en: Wow. Uta-san, you know a lot about this.

records.jp: いえ、それほどでもないと思います。<CR>ただ、どこかで読んだだけですから
records.en_original: No, not much really. It's just something I read somewhere.
records.en: No, not much really. It's just something I read somewhere.

records.jp: でも、それだけで覚えてるってことは、<CR>詩さん、ピアノに興味があったんじゃない？
records.en_original: But even for you to remember that much, were you interested in pianos in the other world?
records.en: But if you remember that much, wasn't Uta-san interested in the piano?

records.jp: 確かに……どこか懐かしさを覚えます
records.en_original: Perhaps... They do feel familiar somehow...
records.en: Perhaps... They do feel familiar somehow...

records.jp: 懐かしさ……か。<CR>もしかして、ピアノの曲をよく聴いてたのかな？
records.en_original: Familiar? Maybe you used to listen to a lot of piano music?
records.en: Familiar? Maybe you used to listen to a lot of piano music?

records.jp: そうなのかもしれません
records.en_original: That may be true.
records.en: That may be true.

records.jp: なんていうかさ、圧がハンパない的な……
records.en_original: I don't know, there's just something intimidating about them, you know?
records.en: I don't know, there's just something intimidating about them, you know?

records.jp: 「圧」……ですか？
records.en_original: Intimidating?
records.en: Intimidating?

records.jp: あ、漂ってくる雰囲気みたいな？<CR>「素人お断り」みたいな威圧感を感じる……
records.en_original: It just has the aura like, "I shall not be played by mere amateurs!"
records.en: It just has the aura like, "I shall not be played by mere amateurs!"

records.jp: 威圧感……つまり星崎さんは、<CR>このピアノが怖いのでしょうか？
records.en_original: When you say intimidating, you mean you're afraid of this piano?
records.en: Intimidating... In other words, are you afraid of this piano, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: あ、そういうわけじゃないんだけど、<CR>ちょっと立派すぎて、畏れ多いなぁ
records.en_original: Not exactly, but something about it is imposing.
records.en: Not exactly, but something about it is imposing.

records.jp: ふふ。いくら立派でも、ピアノはピアノですよ。<CR>ただの道具です
records.en_original: Hehe. No matter how imposing, a piano is a piano. It's just a tool.
records.en: Hehe. No matter how imposing, a piano is a piano. It's just a tool.

records.jp: あ、きれいな音
records.en_original: What a beautiful tone.
records.en: What a beautiful tone.

records.jp: きれい……そうですね。<CR>心地良い音だと、思いました
records.en_original: Beautiful... Yes, you're right. I found it quite nice as well.
records.en: Beautiful... Yes, you're right. I found it quite nice as well.

records.jp: うん。ピアノの音ってやっぱいいなぁ……。<CR>きれいだよね
records.en_original: Yeah, pianos just have such a great tone to them.
records.en: Yeah, pianos just have such a great tone to them.

records.jp: はい。きれいです
records.en_original: Yes, I agree.
records.en: Yes, I agree.

records.jp: だから、こんなピアノを、<CR>きれいに弾きこなせるのって、憧れるなぁ
records.en_original: That's why I always wanted to learn how to play well.
records.en: That's why I always wanted to learn how to play well.

records.jp: 星崎さんは、ピアノは弾けるんですか？
records.en_original: Can you play?
records.en: Can you play the piano, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: もちろん弾けない！　っていうか、習ったことないし。<CR>……詩さんは？
records.en_original: Of course not! I've never even actually tried to learn. How about you?
records.en: Of course I can't! I've never taken lessons. ...What about you, Uta-san?

records.jp: どうでしょう……今のところ、<CR>ピアノを弾いていた記憶はありませんが……
records.en_original: I wonder... I don't have any memories of doing so...
records.en: I wonder... I don't have any memories of doing so...

records.jp: そっかぁ。<CR>どっちかが弾けたら、リサイタルできたのにね
records.en_original: Huh. Too bad, if either of us played, we could have had a recital.
records.en: Huh. Too bad, if either of us played, we could have had a recital.

records.jp: えへへ、弾けるよ！<CR>こうやって……
records.en_original: Hehe, I can! Like this...
records.en: Hehe, I can! Like this...

records.jp: こう、すらーっと踊るように手を動かして<CR>たらららーんって、かっこよくない？
records.en_original: Simply by moving my hands like this, I can make even the most hardened man fall to his knees and weep.
records.en: Simply by moving my hands like this, I can make even the most hardened man fall to his knees and weep.

records.jp: 星崎さんのその仕草は素敵だと思います
records.en_original: That sounds like quite the performance.
records.en: I think that gesture of Hoshizaki-san's is lovely.

records.jp: ……ごめん。<CR>実は、弾けないんだ
records.en_original: ...Sorry, I lied. I can't actually play at all.
records.en: ...Sorry, I lied. I can't actually play at all.

records.jp: どうして謝るんですか？<CR>私はいまの星崎さんの仕草、楽しかったですよ
records.en_original: Why are you apologizing? I quite enjoyed the performance you just gave me.
records.en: Why are you apologizing?<CR>I enjoyed that gesture of yours just now, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: く……やめておけばよかった……！
records.en_original: Gah! I should've kept my dumb mouth shut!
records.en: Gah! I should've kept my dumb mouth shut!

records.jp: 詩さんちょっと弾いてみてよ。<CR>もしかしたら、できるかもしれないし？
records.en_original: Why don't you try playing a bit, Uta? Who knows, you may actually be able to.
records.en: Why don't you try playing a bit, Uta-san? Who knows, you may actually be able to.

records.jp: 私がですか……？
records.en_original: Me?
records.en: Me?

records.jp: ……わかりました、やってみます
records.en_original: Okay. I'll try.
records.en: Okay. I'll try.

records.jp: えっ？　えっ！？　すごい！　弾けるの！？
records.en_original: H-huh?! Whoa! You're doing it! That's amazing!
records.en: H-huh?! Whoa! You're doing it! That's amazing!

records.jp: なぜだか、指が勝手に動いて……
records.en_original: My fingers just started moving on their own...
records.en: My fingers just started moving on their own...

records.jp: ……思い出しました。<CR>私、オルガンを弾いていたことがあります
records.en_original: I remember now... I used to play the organ once.
records.en: I remember now... I used to play the organ once.

records.jp: 忘れていても……体は覚えているものですね
records.en_original: I've forgotten, but it seems as though my body still remembers.
records.en: I've forgotten, but it seems as though my body still remembers.

records.jp: リサイタルしようよ！<CR>みんなもきっと喜んでくれるよ！
records.en_original: Let's have a recital! Everyone'll love it!
records.en: Let's have a recital! Everyone'll love it!

records.jp: それは……ちょっと怖いです。<CR>そんな大した腕ではありませんし、それに……
records.en_original: I...can't help but feel a little scared. I'm not very good...
records.en: I...can't help but feel a little scared. I'm not very good...

records.jp: 私が良いと思った曲が、皆さんには響かなかったらと<CR>思うと……
records.en_original: What if no one likes the piece I choose...
records.en: What if no one likes the piece I choose...

records.jp: 詩さん……
records.en_original: Uta...
records.en: Uta-san...

records.jp: じゃあ、私だけでいいから聴かせてくれないかな？<CR>私は、詩さんの曲、すごくいいと思ったから……
records.en_original: Then how about just playing for me then? I really like what I've heard so far.
records.en: Then could you play it just for me? I thought Uta-san's song was really good...

records.jp: 星崎さんのためだけのリサイタル、ですね。<CR>……ふふ、それならいいですよ
records.en_original: A private recital for Ao Hoshizaki. Hehe. I wouldn't mind that.
records.en: A recital just for you, Hoshizaki-san. Hehe... I wouldn't mind that.

records.jp: 聴いてください。<CR>他にもこんな曲が弾けるんです――
records.en_original: I hope you enjoy yourself. This is another song I know.
records.en: I hope you enjoy yourself. This is another song I know.

records.jp: 弾き方教えて！　私も弾けるようになりたい！
records.en_original: Teach me how to play! I wanna learn!
records.en: Teach me how to play! I wanna learn!

records.jp: いいですが……教えられるほどの腕ではありませんよ？
records.en_original: I don't mind, but... I don't know if I'm good enough to teach another person how to play.
records.en: I don't mind, but... I don't know if I'm good enough to teach another person how to play.

records.jp: そんなことないよ！<CR>さっきの曲、すごいきれいだったし！
records.en_original: That's not true! The song you played just now was beautiful!
records.en: That's not true! The song you played just now was beautiful!

records.jp: きれい……
records.en_original: Beautiful...
records.en: Beautiful...

records.jp: ……わかりました。<CR>でしたら、一緒に練習しませんか？
records.en_original: Okay, then. If you really want to, let's practice together.
records.en: Okay, then. If you really want to, let's practice together.

records.jp: 私ももっときれいな曲を弾けるように練習します。<CR>いつか一緒に、連弾しましょう
records.en_original: I'll try my best to play even more beautifully. I hope we'll be able to play a duet one day.
records.en: I'll try my best to play even more beautifully. I hope we'll be able to play a duet one day.

records.jp: それいいね！　ちゃんと練習しなくちゃ……
records.en_original: That sounds great! Guess I'll have to actually practice...
records.en: That sounds great! Guess I'll have to actually practice...

records.jp: ……ふふ。どんな音色になるか、楽しみです
records.en_original: Hehe. I look forward to hearing how you play.
records.en: Hehe. I look forward to hearing how you play.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
